content: MK on Qāżīzāda Rūmī, the observatory's second director: he "was a friend to Ibn Turka from childhood, and the two carried on a warm correspondence"; MK reads it as no coincidence that Ibn Turka completed the Mafāḥiṣ "in 1420, the same year construction of the Samarkand Observatory was begun."
